name: unsafe fn read_volatile < T > (src : * const T) -> T
rule: A pointer obtained by casting a reference is guaranteed valid for `read_volatile` while the underlying object remains live and no reference is used to access the same memory; under this guarantee, reference accesses and raw-pointer accesses cannot be interleaved.
